skill.name: copy-editing
skill.description: Edit and refresh existing marketing copy through focused passes for clarity, voice, proof, specificity, emotional impact, conversion friction, and AI-generated writing patterns.
skill.summary: A structured workflow for improving existing marketing copy without changing its core message.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All five static findings are false positives. The flagged backticks are inline Markdown examples or a file-existence check. The reconnaissance matches are ordinary editorial terms, with no executable command or malicious intent found.

static_findings.snippet: Present the gap grid and a proposed outline before rewriting. Mark each section **Keep**, **Revise**
**How to fix:** go back to the facts (the mechanism, number, customer, or step) and rewrite from tho

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged text asks the editor to present a gap grid and outline before rewriting. It is ordinary workflow guidance, not system reconnaissance or an operational instruction.
The match is the word 'aforesaid' in a plain-English replacement table. It is editorial reference content with no system access or reconnaissance behavior.
The match is the word 'outstanding' in a plain-English replacement table. It is editorial reference content with no system access or reconnaissance behavior.
The backticks identify possible Markdown file paths that the editor may read for product context. No shell command or command execution is present.
The backticks mark editorial examples such as writing from facts and using a placeholder. They are formatting examples, not executable shell syntax.

content.value_statement: Marketing teams often have useful copy that is unclear, generic, or outdated. This skill applies focused editing passes to improve clarity and conversion while preserving the original message.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests as full editing, real-voice restoration, or point edits.
Runs seven focused sweeps for clarity, tone, benefits, proof, specificity, emotion, and conversion friction.
Detects vague claims, filler, weak calls to action, unsupported proof, and common AI writing patterns.
Refreshes existing content by checking freshness, accuracy, voice, search intent, proof, and structure.
Produces specific rewrites without inventing statistics, customers, or results.
limitations: It improves existing copy and does not replace a full copywriting strategy for new pages.
It cannot verify claims, customer results, or current market data without source material.
It does not perform live search, analytics, or publishing actions.
It cannot guarantee rankings, traffic, conversion rates, or brand approval.

use_cases.title: Improve a Landing Page
use_cases.description: Review existing landing page copy for clarity, benefits, proof, specificity, and stronger calls to action.

use_cases.title: Refresh an Aging Article
use_cases.description: Audit an existing article for stale facts, changed search intent, missing proof, and structural gaps before rewriting.

use_cases.title: Tighten One Message
use_cases.description: Make a headline, paragraph, testimonial, or call to action more direct while leaving unrelated copy unchanged.
use_cases.target_user: Founders, product marketers, and busy reviewers

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Short Paragraph
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this paragraph for clarity and concision. Preserve the meaning, identify the main issue, and provide one improved version.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Copy Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this marketing page with the seven sweeps. List the highest-impact issues, explain each reason, and provide a revised version using only supported facts.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh Existing Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this published article for freshness, accuracy, voice, search intent, proof, and structure. Show the content gaps, recommend refresh or rewrite, then propose an updated outline.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Multi-Persona Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Assemble four relevant expert personas for this launch page. Score clarity, conversion, trust, and audience fit from one to ten, give specific fixes, revise the copy, and rescore it.

output_examples.input: Our powerful platform helps businesses optimize workflows and achieve meaningful results.
output_examples.output: The claim is vague because it does not name the workflow, audience, or result. Revised: Describe the exact task the platform improves and the measurable outcome you can support.

output_examples.input: Quick edit: Better invoicing for small agencies.
output_examples.output: Revised headline: Send milestone invoices and get paid sooner. Reason: It names the trigger and outcome while staying concise.

output_examples.input: Refresh this article that has outdated statistics and old product examples.
output: Verify every statistic and replace deprecated examples.
Check current search intent and competitor coverage.
Update the outline before rewriting the affected sections.

best_practices: Provide the audience, goal, desired action, and available proof before editing.
Ask for a point edit when only one line should change.
Supply source material for claims, statistics, customer results, and brand voice.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent proof, customer results, or market data.
Do not use a full seven-sweep review for a narrowly scoped point edit.
Do not request fresh page copy when a dedicated copywriting workflow is required.

faq.question: Is this skill for new copy?
faq.answer: It is designed for improving existing copy. Use a copywriting workflow for a page written from scratch.

faq.question: Can it preserve my brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide brand guidance, and the workflow checks tone while preserving the original argument and useful wording.

faq.question: What are the seven sweeps?
faq.answer: They cover clarity, voice, benefits, proof, specificity, emotional impact, and barriers to action.

faq.question: Can it remove AI-style writing?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks for contrast reveals, negation lists, stock phrases, vague wording, and trailing clauses.

faq.question: Can it refresh outdated content?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks freshness, accuracy, search intent, proof, structure, and whether the page needs a refresh or rewrite.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better rankings or conversions?
faq.answer: No. It can improve copy quality, but rankings, conversions, and approval depend on evidence, audience, strategy, and execution.
